This fall I am teaching SPED 687: Early Intervention Methods I in the University of Oregon's EI/ECSE master's program, the same program I graduated from eight years ago.

A lot has happened in between: seven years as an EI/ECSE Specialist, coaching families of toddlers, and a doctorate focused on equity in Oregon's Early Intervention data. It is a good feeling to bring all of that back to the place where it started.

Looking forward to working with this cohort of future early interventionists.
